Stasher is thrilled to introduce our new Laundry Detergent Sheets – a revolutionary way to clean your clothes that aligns perfectly with your goal to live Life with Less Plastic™. We've harnessed the power of a deep clean into a compact, eco-friendly sheet, transforming your wash day from messy and wasteful to effortless and sustainable. Discover a smarter approach to laundry that's kind to your fabrics, your family, and the planet


SPECS
15 LAUNDRY DETERGENT SHEETS (15 half sheets for up to 30 loads)





Pre-Measured Sheets: Dissolve quickly and completely in hot or cold water for ultimate convenience.
Powerful Clean & Pure Formula: Effectively tackles everyday dirt and stubborn stains. Free from fragrances, dyes, phosphates, and parabens – gentle on skin and clothes.
Mess-Free Convenience: Say goodbye to sticky spills, heavy jugs, and wasteful measuring. Compact & lightweight, easy to store and travel with.
HE & Standard Washer Safe: Compatible with all washing machine types, ensuring versatile use.
Plastic-Free Laundry: Replaces bulky plastic detergent jugs, making a tangible impact on waste
